native_context: Native bounds, ownership and object lifetime
taxonomy_note: Planning lens only; actual root-cause mapping is independent.

controls.boundary: Native bounds, ownership and object lifetime — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Trace input-controlled sizes/indexes and object ownership through allocation, transfer, free and dereference. Record C/C++ build flags, ABI and reachable parser/entrypoint.
controls.controlled_verification: Create a small local harness around the actual function with nonsecret bounded input. Use an available sanitizer/debugger to tie the failing access to object bounds/lifetime and preserve stack/source evidence. Compare a valid neighboring input and the repaired ownership/bounds behavior.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A crash is not automatically exploitable code execution. A sanitizer report in an unreachable harness path needs application reachability separately; absence of a report is not a safety proof.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Repair the ownership/length invariant at its source, not merely suppress the symptom. Retest the original failure, valid edge inputs and cleanup using the same build identity.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
